title: Lessing
html_source:
Gotthold Ephraim Lessing, (born Jan. 22, 1729, Kamenz, Upper Lusatia, Saxony [Germany]—died Feb. 15, 1781, Braunschweig, Brunswick [Germany]) German dramatist, critic, and writer on philosophy and aesthetics.
